agent_explanation: NS green starts ~2270 and is still held at 2461 (~190+s green, max_green 80). S detector_fail from t=2325 blinds the controller to S queue; actuated logic that should cap green at max_green_seconds and recall waiting EW appears not to fire while a detector is failed, so NS green sticks indefinitely and EW (E,W queues ~200) wait 201s > 200 limit. Removing the detector_fail removes the failure.
